versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_dismhost:
    Image|endswith: '\DismHost.exe' 
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/online'
        - '/Disable-Feature'
        - '/FeatureName:'
        - '/Remove'
        #/NoRestart
        #/quiet
selection_dism:
    Image|endswith: '\Dism.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/online'
        - '/Disable-Feature'
        - '/FeatureName:'
        - '/Remove'
        #/NoRestart
        #/quiet
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (Image="*\\DismHost.exe" ParentCommandLine="*/online*" ParentCommandLine="*/Disable-Feature*" ParentCommandLine="*/FeatureName:*" ParentCommandLine="*/Remove*") OR (Image="*\\Dism.exe" CommandLine="*/online*" CommandLine="*/Disable-Feature*" CommandLine="*/FeatureName:*" CommandLine="*/Remove*")
